L131: # The ECI frontier has advanced by 14 points per year since the introduction of reasoning models
L132: 
L133: Cite
L134: 
L135: By cite43†Alexander Barry L136: 
L137: Following the introduction of the first reasoning models (OpenAI’s o1-mini and o1-preview) in September 2024, the cite44†Epoch Capabilities Index (ECI) frontier has advanced linearly by 14 points per year, compared with 6 points per year for non-reasoning models.
